when.Critical: must fix before the gate is crossed
when.Important: fix before the gate if cheap; blocks until disposed
when.Minor: note for the close review; never blocks a gate

whenDisposed.addressed: the plan changed to satisfy this finding
whenDisposed.not-addressed: still open — the judge re-raises it this round
whenDisposed.withdrawn: the judge retracts it (mistaken, or overtaken by a design change)
whenDisposed.disputed: the implementer declines it with a rationale and a counter-measurement; it settles unless its severity is appeal-only, and the next judge answers it
